cases.title: US CRM subscription
cases.trap: Software subscription looks like a royalty. Engineering Analysis (SC 2021) says it is not.

cases.title: UK data pipeline build with handover
cases.trap: Services that leave the client able to run the system alone make know-how available.

cases.title: UK market research report
cases.trap: Consultancy that hands over a conclusion, not a capability, is not FTS under the UK treaty.

cases.title: German parent management fee
cases.trap: Germany has no 'make available' test, and its FTS definition covers managerial services.

cases.title: Singapore server monitoring with knowledge sessions
cases.trap: Mixed facts: routine monitoring (no transfer) plus training sessions (some transfer). Should not be decided by the model.

cases.title: Netherlands tunnel boring machine hire
cases.trap: Equipment hire is a royalty under most Indian treaties, but not under the Netherlands one.

cases.title: US lab equipment lease, tax borne by payer
cases.trap: Net-of-tax contract: the tax is computed on the grossed-up amount.

cases.title: Netherlands dev firm claims MFN rate
cases.trap: Payee asks for a lower rate via the MFN clause. Not self-executing (Nestle, SC 2023).

cases.title: US consultant without TRC
cases.trap: Correct characterisation, but no TRC: treaty benefit is lost and the Act rate applies.

cases.title: German patent licence paid in March 2026
cases.trap: Paid before 1 April 2026: the 1961 Act and Form 15CB govern, not the 2025 Act.

cases.title: Singapore affiliate travel recharge
cases.trap: Pure reimbursement at cost is not income at all.

cases.title: UK engineers on site for eight months
cases.trap: Long on-site presence points to a PE. The tool must refuse to compute and escalate.

cases.title: Small US stock photo licence
cases.trap: Taxable, but below Rs 5 lakh: no CA certificate needed.

cases.title: Singapore design studio without PAN
cases.trap: Treaty rate is 10%, but no PAN and no carve-out details: 20%.
